source_artifact_path: services/legacy-billing/db/oracle/ (OW_BILLING.CUSTOMER_MASTER 155 cols + ENTITY_ATTR_VALUE), seeded by testdata/legacy/oracle_billing_seed.py
golden_baseline_location: testdata/legacy/manifests/<ns>.json (targets oracle.OW_BILLING.CUSTOMER_MASTER rows=25000 checksum=4f92feef2ad58dbab30e289957931928, ENTITY_ATTR_VALUE rows=8333 at NS=demo)

acceptance_checks.description: customers collection holds exactly the manifest CUSTOMER_MASTER row count (25000 at NS=demo), one document per customer.
order-independent md5 checksum (testdata/legacy/legacy_common.py checksum_lines line format) recomputed from the target collection matches manifest checksum for CUSTOMER_MASTER.
all 8333 ENTITY_ATTR_VALUE rows fold into the owning customer document's attributes subdocument; sum of attributes entries across documents equals the manifest EAV row count.
RELATED_ACCT_IDS / PROMO_CODES_CSV become real arrays; malformed CSV lists are quarantined with attribution, never silently coerced.
valid DD-MON-YY VARCHAR2 dates become BSON dates; dirty SIGNUP_DT values are quarantined and enumerated.

encoding_policy.input_encoding: UTF-8 as stored in Oracle VARCHAR2 (AL32UTF8)
encoding_policy.byte_transparency: string fields are carried byte-for-byte; no re-encoding or normalization
encoding_policy.invalid_bytes: a value that does not decode as UTF-8 quarantines the record with attribution; never dropped or mangled

malformed_record_policy.details: NULL/missing source values are omitted fields in the document, never fabricated defaults; a NULL may never fail open into a valid-looking value. Malformed CSV lists and unparseable dates go to the quarantine collection with source PK and reason.

empty_input_semantics.details: a run against an empty/absent source namespace writes nothing and leaves prior target output untouched.

planted_anomalies.description: 50 dirty SIGNUP_DT strings such as 31-FEB-24 and N/A (manifest kind=dirty_dates)
